desc: Read K, S, and T from standard input as bytes and immediately reject if abs(len(S)-len(T)) > K.
Trim common prefix and common suffix safely to reduce the effective problem size.
Build double 64-bit rolling-hash prefix arrays and power arrays for the trimmed strings.
Implement an O(log N) LCP query using double-hash equality with binary search.
Implement the Landau-Vishkin furthest-reaching DP over edit counts 0..K and diagonals -e..e, with correct insert/delete/substitute transitions and boundary checks.
Add early termination: output Yes as soon as a state reaches the end of both strings, and output No if no state succeeds within K edits.
Handle edge cases: one string empty after trimming, K larger than remaining length, identical strings, and length difference exactly K.
Run the provided sample tests and additional edge-case tests to confirm correctness and performance.
